items.title: Jev is incredible
items.summary:
Jev is a brand new Typesafe model that's a fast classifier with tons of perks and safety, but it doesn't replace reasoning models like Astra/Fable.

Thank you Depot for sponsoring! Check them out at: https://soydev.link/depot

Sources:

https://typesafe.ai/blog/introducing-system-one-models-and-jev
https://flaviocopes.com/jev/

Want to sponsor a video? Learn more here: https://soydev.link/sponsor-me

Check out my Twitch, Twitter, Discord more at https://t3.gg

S/O @Ph4seon3 for the awesome edit 🙏

items.title: The Danger of AI Isn't an Off-Switch
items.summary:
I'm not worried about AI suddenly doing something we don't understand, I'm worried about not noticing it till it's to late 

Want to sponsor a video? Learn more here: https://soydev.link/sponsor-me

#coding #programming #ai
items.author: Theo - t3․gg
items.transcript: I feel like a lot of people think the concern is that the model might escape. That's not the case at all. I'm worried about it doing really sketchy stuff when it's on, and by the time we notice and turn it off, it's already too late. There are viruses that still get around to this day whose creators are dead and the servers they phone home to don't exist anymore. It doesn't matter when the worms are written properly. They can just keep perpetuating themselves indefinitely.

items.title: Please stop using stupid models
items.summary:
